# ADR-3258: AWS root_mfa: Root access key creation for account 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Root access keys are almost is expected to justified.

## Decision

Operators SHALL NOT perform a root access key creation for account 2 (AWS-root_mfa-2).

## Consequences

SCPs deny root key creation.
